description: P0-7 (PRIORITY-0.md): every durable boundary the code has (scripts/durable-boundaries.mjs finds them) and the tests that kill, retry or restart right after it and check that what was made durable means what it meant. Generated owners are checked against the code; a new boundary without an entry fails the gate. Each test says how it stops the process (injection: sigkill, in-process-fault or logical, P0V-83), and the gate checks that the test's code shows it.

boundaries.fact: actual SIGKILL after batch JSON or delivery-index replacement and parent flush followed by two fresh-process projections preserves original prepared batch identity, incarnation, session, delivery mode, complete message IDs, accepted operations and delivery rows. Each separately timed navigation links its exact immutable inbox generation; later observations cannot mutate earlier generation bytes. It injects no body, ACK, approval or completion. Supplied authentication and process SIGKILL are not whole-broker crash, kernel containment or power-loss qualification
